title: Efficient Learning and Symmetry Discovery under Exact Invariances
abstract: arXiv:2609.07031v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning with group invariances is central to many scientific and geometric learning problems, yet its computational foundations remain poorly understood. Even for classical supervised regression settings, it has been unclear whether one can efficiently compute a regression function that is exactly invariant to a given group action. Recent work showed that exact invariance can be enforced in polynomial time when the underlying group is finite and known, but left open the cases of infinite groups and unknown symmetries. In this paper, we resolve both challenges. First, we present the first polynomial-time algorithm for learning with exact group invariances that applies uniformly to finite and infinite groups. The runtime is polynomial in the data dimension and sample size, and independent of the group, while achieving strong generalization guarantees. translated_title: 精确不变性下的高效学习与对称性发现
translated_abstract: 具有群不变性的学习是许多科学和几何学习问题的核心，但其计算基础仍知之甚少。即使在经典的监督回归设置中，人们也不清楚是否能够高效地计算一个对给定群作用精确不变的回归函数。近期的研究表明，当底层群是有限且已知时，可以在多项式时间内强制实现精确不变性，但无限群和未知对称性的情形仍是悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们解决了这两个挑战。首先，我们提出了首个适用于有限群和无限群的、具有精确群不变性学习的多项式时间算法。该算法的运行时间是数据维度和样本量的多项式，且与群本身无关，同时能实现强泛化保证。这为不变与等变模型的实证成功提供了计算层面的解释……
tldr: 该论文首次提出了统一适用于有限群和无限群的精确群不变性学习多项式时间算法，解决了无限群和未知对称性情形下高效学习的开放性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first polynomial-time algorithm for learning with exact group invariances that uniformly applies to both finite and infinite groups, resolving the open challenges of efficient learning under infinite groups and unknown symmetries.
